formulas.tex: \term{receiver}{r}(c) = \operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k}\ \frac{\term{surface}{\tilde z_c} - \term{neighborSurface}{\tilde z_k}}{\term{groundDistance}{d_k}},\quad \tilde z_c = \max\!\bigl(z_c,\ \min_n \tilde z_n + \term{epsilon}{\varepsilon}\bigr),\quad \term{accumulation}{A}(c) = \term{weight}{w_c} + \sum_{u:\ r(u) = c} A(u)
formulas.ascii: r(c) = argmax over the 8 neighbours k of (zf(c) - zf(k)) / d_k where zf is the filled surface, d_k = cell size (cardinal) or sqrt(2) * cell size (diagonal), only drops > 0 route, ties keep the lowest direction index; zf(c) = max(z(c), min over neighbours of zf(n) + epsilon) with boundary cells keeping z; A(c) = w(c) + sum of A(u) over donors u with r(u) = c, w = runoff (1 here), solved by pull rounds: a thread finalizes a cell once every donor is final and then walks downstream (up to 1024 steps); streams = A >= threshold
